say:0:1910323001:0.text: 地上的珊瑚粉末中仍隐隐流动着微弱的光辉。你怀揣着希望，俯下身捻起一点仔细查看。
say:0:1910323001:0.source_cn: 地上的珊瑚粉末中仍隐隐流动着微弱的光辉。你怀揣着希望，...

say:1:1910323002:0.text: 遗憾的是，你几乎无法探测到任何魔法波动。这枝子瑚的损坏远比前两处更为严重，即便是你，也无法在短时间内让它恢复而初。
say:1:1910323002:0.source_cn: 遗憾的是，你几乎无法探测到任何魔法波动。这枝子瑚的损坏...

say:4:1910323004:0.text: No... I refuse to believe it! <style="stress"><player_name></style> and Tolan, I'll go get Grandma! She'll know what to do!
say:4:1910323004:0.male: No... I refuse to believe it! <style="stress"><player_name></style> and Tolan, I'll go get Grandma! She'll know what to do!
say:4:1910323004:0.female: No... I refuse to believe it! <style="stress"><player_name></style> and Tolan, I'll go get Grandma! She'll know what to do!

narration:6:1910323005:0.text: Elphira sprints off toward the Cradle Pool. Moments later, the clan representatives arrive one after another...
narration:6:1910323005:0.source_cn: 艾菲拉转身向繁育池的方向飞速跑去。不一会，各大家族代表...

say:8:1910323006:1.text: Thank you, everyone! Repairs to the Cradle Pool are nearly complete, and Mother Coral has largely recovered. You all deserve the credit.
say:8:1910323006:1.source_cn: 感谢各位的帮助，繁育池已经基本修复完毕，母瑚也已恢复了...

say:10:1910323007:1.source_cn: 孩子们，你们做得非常好，辛苦了。

say:12:1910323008:1.text: Grandma, this Coral Sprout is smashed to smithereens... Is there any hope of salvaging it?
say:12:1910323008:1.source_cn: 阿嬷，可是这枝子瑚完全被压坏了，会不会……修不好了？

say:14:1910323009:1.text: Fret not, Elphira. Coral Sprouts can be restored.
say:14:1910323009:1.source_cn: 不要慌张，海月艾菲拉。子瑚是能够被修复的。

say:16:1910323010:1.text: Really? The coral's one tough cookie!
say:16:1910323010:1.source_cn: 碎成这样还能恢复？这大珊瑚也太强悍了点吧！

say:17:1910323011:1.text: Coral Sprouts aren't actually coral. They're energy condensed into physical form.
say:17:1910323011:1.source_cn: 子瑚并非真正的珊瑚，而是能量的凝聚。

say:18:1910323012:1.text: Just infuse them with enough energy, and they'll be as good as new.
say:18:1910323012:1.source_cn: 只要注入足够的能量，它就能恢复如初。

choice_prompt:19:1910323012.text: Just infuse them with enough energy, and they'll be as good as new.
choice_prompt:19:1910323012.source_cn: 只要注入足够的能量，它就能恢复如初。

say:21:1910323013:1.text: I'm afraid so, my dear. But I believe we can do it if we work together.
say:21:1910323013:1.source_cn: 是的，亲爱的孩子。但只要我们齐心协力，就能够做到。

say:22:1910323014:1.text: A single stream may be weak, but when joined by others, it can form a wave strong enough to shake the reefs.
say:22:1910323014:1.source_cn: 即便是最柔软的水流，汇聚在一处时，亦能化作足以撼动礁岸...

say:23:1910323015:1.text: Come, everyone. Let us all do our part to protect our home.
say:23:1910323015:1.source_cn: 来吧，家人们。为保护我们的家园，贡献出自己的一份力量。

choice:19:0:1.text: Restoring this one will take an enormous amount of energy.
choice:19:0:1.source_cn: 让它恢复需要非常多的能量
choice:19:0:1.male: Restoring this one will take an enormous amount of energy.
choice:19:0:1.female: Restoring this one will take an enormous amount of energy.
